purpose: review each new or changed dependency for provenance, vulnerabilities and license fit before it is merged
entry_criteria: A pull request adds or changes a dependency
License policy and approved-registry list exist
inputs: the package's maintainer and release history
procedure: List each added or changed package, including transitive ones introduced by the lockfile diff.
Check provenance: official registry, maintainer activity, release age, download and repository signals, and typosquat look-alikes.
Check advisories and the license of each package against the policy; note copyleft or unknown licenses.
Check whether the dependency is needed or whether existing code or the standard library covers it.
Record approve, reject or approve-with-condition per package with the reason.
Require pinned versions and a lockfile change in the same pull request.
acceptance_criteria: Every added package has a recorded decision
No unknown or policy-forbidden license is approved
Versions are pinned in the lockfile
Reviewer is not the author of the change
validation_method: Independent reviewer confirms findings and disposition.

validation.command: git diff origin/main...HEAD -- package-lock.json requirements.txt   # example lockfiles
validation.expect: every added or changed package appears in the review record

validation.command: pip-audit -r requirements.txt   # example; use the ecosystem's audit tool
validation.expect: no unresolved high or critical advisory

failure_modes.detection: Name differs by a character from a popular package
Lockfile diff shows packages not in the record

failure_modes.response: Reject or ask legal for a written decision

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A pull request adds a small date library. Review finds the same function already exists in the standard library, so the dependency is rejected and the author uses the standard function.
